name: anim_dobe_hugs_wani
subject: a pink goo Doberman monster lying on top of a pink goo crocodile monster on a sticky paint puddle, with a small black witch cat squashed between them
desc: Only the Doberman on top moves: it wraps both of its thick arms around the crocodile's body and shoulders and hugs it tightly, pulling it close. The crocodile underneath does not move or change at all: same head, same face, same eyes, same pose, same colors. Keep the Doberman's head with tall ears on the upper left, the same colors and yellow marble streaks.
